name: prompt-template-editor
title: PromptTemplateEditor
description: Controlled prompt-template editor: a Textarea plus a simple hint area listing available variables and which are used vs missing. The hint is a lightweight overlay over the plain textarea (no CodeMirror / editor library) — variable detection uses the pure extractVars helper that recognizes both mustache ({{name}}) and f-string ({name}) placeholders, deduped in order. 'Used' = the variable appears in the value; 'missing' = used in the value but not declared. Composes Textarea/Badge — zero new dependency.
